name: 敵_騎馬弓兵_やられ_4コマ_v2.png
prompt:
Use case: game-asset
Asset type: 4-frame enemy sprite strip for a 2D Sengoku beat-'em-up
Input images: Image 1 is the character reference sheet. Match ONLY the mounted archer in the lower-right figure: blue armor and clothing, dark blue helmet with pink-red plume, quiver of arrows, long Japanese yumi bow, same face and proportions. Ignore the horse and all other figures.
Primary request: Create one continuous four-frame defeated animation of this same cavalry archer after being thrown from his horse. The horse is completely absent in every frame. Frame 1: the archer lands on his left side facing right, one arm catches the impact. Frame 2: his torso and legs settle lower, bow remains with him at a natural human scale. Frame 3: he finishes rolling onto his side, knees slightly bent, face still oriented right. Frame 4: the same final lying pose, only a tiny settling movement in plume and cloth. Read as one smooth fall-to-stillness animation, not four unrelated poses.
Style/medium: detailed painted anime-realistic 2D arcade game sprite, crisp dark outline, cel-shaded highlights, realistic Sengoku armor and cloth; match the reference sheet's palette and line style.
Composition/framing: one horizontal row with exactly four equal 384x384 square cells, total 1536x384. One complete archer in each cell. The body is naturally horizontal while lying, not shrunk; keep his head, torso, limbs and equipment at the same physical scale as the mounted-archer rider in the reference. Keep all parts at least 20 px from each cell edge. Keep each pose strictly within its own cell.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid RGB(255,0,255) magenta (#FF00FF), no floor or cast shadow.
Constraints: preserve the rider's blue armor, plume, face, quiver and yumi. The bow stays beside or across the body at its normal realistic size. Keep the whole figure and bow visible in each cell. No horse, saddle, horse tack, other people or extra props.
Avoid: text, letters, numbers, labels, borders, cell dividers, effects, blood, background scenery, duplicated body parts, floating weapons, scale changes, perspective distortion, watermark.
